component.name: Nib
component.summary: Use your tablet as a stylus-ready second display for GNOME

description.p: Nib turns your Android tablet or iPad into a low-latency external display for GNOME, with full touch, gesture, and active stylus/pencil support.

ul.li: Extend your GNOME desktop or mirror your main display
Multi-finger trackpad gestures: click, right-click, scroll, and workspace switching
Pressure- and tilt-aware stylus input for Krita, GIMP, and Inkscape
Connect over USB or Wi-Fi, with support for multiple devices at once
